scope.phaseOrder: DETACH -> RELEASE -> MERGE -> ACCOUNT -> PHASE_COMPLETE; new still objects are a separate owner generation, not part of the frozen sweep
scope.publication: The actual native owner sets OWNER_CLEANUP after restored-stack barrier and task claim. It moves the old chain into VM-owned cleanup.pending, records survivors plus in-flight base/native payload/release function before invoking callbacks; callback allocations publish to a fresh chain. After all known returns it merges survivors and fresh objects, recounts actual lengths and clears deferred accounting before ROOTS_FROZEN/task completion
scope.affinity: R owner services retain actual pthread/PSTATE, independently of W. Selected release callbacks may allocate and fully initialize noncollecting still objects, with explicit still refcount roots. This is not permission to use unregistered movable pointers, generated SFUN argument writes or a different owner
scope.custody: Fresh list is never overwritten by the old sweep tail. Detached pending/survivor chains and in-flight native identity live in fixed VM storage, not solely a C activation; nonempty escrow refuses slot setup. Same-carrier shutdown is refused before interrupt/resize destruction. A collecting allocation fails before starting a nested GC or publishing an object. Public GC and low-level call/run entries refuse before collective or managed-frame effects. Nonreturning callback exits leave VM-owned pending/inflight custody and an incomplete task; native result/stop recovery is not proved and cannot justify replay. A normal C return carrying a release error still uses the legacy result policy and does not prove resource disposition
scope.retired: Replace sweep mutation of the public still head during native releases; remove the unconditional deferred-counter reset that could discard callback-created objects. One run_function type in runtime_forwards now drives public import, function-table field and implementation forward declaration; the definition is compiler-checked against it. Independent expected C types and real calls remain separate controls. Native cleanup no longer silently reenters the current GC collective or creates a managed activation from a physical restore receipt
scope.overheads: Five pointer-sized fields per fixed participant retain pending/survivor/inflight/native payload/function identity, plus one fresh-chain recount; no dynamic metadata allocation or extra barrier. One phase enum value and constant-time entry checks. All callback-created still/native resources consume existing heap and remain until their real subsequent release; no heap multiplier or pause-speed claim
scope.qualification: Require exact-source, original-profile, same-workspace, domain-kernel, topology-and-map, refill-exercised, calibrated-unknown-join, authenticated-executions, bounded-budgets, owner-domain-service, fresh-still-generation, refusal-before-effects, native-run-abi, write-authority, copy-before-reserve. Independent C Generic type checks must match public declaration and function table, and the real callback must call the correct current ABI. The root kernel compiles the actual write_authority implementation and shared component controls; source relocations must remove every old API/file name without aliases. Actual callbacks must allocate child FOREIGN objects, retain them in the owner chain, drop roots, finalize once in the next epoch, and reject call/run/GC/collecting-allocation/shutdown attempts before register/stack/catcher/setup-state changes; observe escrow during callbacks and empty after completion
scope.remaining: Complete copy-capacity plan and arbitrary native writer closure remain open. Generated SFUN conversion can write before call, raw RC/payload setters are unmediated, nonlocal native exits need escrow and no-write evidence, teardown free_still_objs is a separate producer, and known callback completion does not prove native resource release after an error
scope.modelOwnership: Existing QNT root_producer_closure/copy_custody owns producer closure and in-flight history; existing Lean RootProducerClosure/CopyCustody owns source/refinement premises. SysML records actual source boundaries and negative evidence; ASCENT may qualify this owner-service slice but cannot discharge the whole native-writer condition
